As part of a YouTube-sponsored project at SMIX.LAB, current AI tools in music and the music business were researched, described according to use cases, and summarized in two toolboards.

The legal framework for the use of AI in the music industry is the subject of legal policy debates and has not yet been conclusively clarified—especially with regard to copyright, training data, and licenses. The Fairly Trained initiative advocates for the transparent, legally compliant, and ethically responsible use of AI training data. In our database, we have marked tools that have been proven to have been trained under fair conditions.
